Personal note — the night shift: wash off the white crystals left by the livestock-feed study crew. the creek smelled wrong, and I had not yet heard that the siren began.

I folded the corner so I could find the entry again. Someone wanted the book put away before I had even finished copying it.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.

row.body:
I heard someone knock while I was hiding here. He said he was checking the rooms and read a list aloud.

The name of the person with me was on it, though she had not told anyone we were here. She whispered that they had copied an older list from another building.

He left after we stayed quiet. I wrote the names I could remember so I can ask her later where that list came from.
row.title: The names beyond the door
